liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The French Girl** (1 review): Jerry on pedal steel makes this track tearful, and Dylan remembers the words [14]
- **Joey** (1 review): The reviewer notes this version of the song smokes [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-01.sbd-rehearsals.fraser.97489.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 74 songs; 318 min; rated 4.45/5 by 47 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry plays steel guitar on some tracks, though some songs are rough; The recording has great sound quality and contains no jamming [4][5]
- **gd1987-06-01.147314.sbd.flac1648**: soundboard; 11 songs; 44 min [2]

## Around the show

- Dylan mentioned in Chronicles that the Dead pushed him to revitalize old songs [8]
- The reviewer lives in San Rafael and finds the music made there magical [12]
- This material is much better than the commercial Dylan and Dead album [9]
- Rehearsals seemed more focused and energetic than the live concert release [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-01.sbd-rehearsals.fraser.97489.shnf**: source: SBD > MC [1]. Also: Alan Fraser donated soundboard cassettes transferred to DAT, then CD-R [1]
- **gd1987-06-01.147314.sbd.flac1648**: taped by Unknown; transferred by LTA; source: cassette (soundboard) > DAT > Maxell DM 120 Digital Audio Tape Back Coated (DAT clone 26-11-1996 from Jed) [2]
